lines.text: Many learners say: We discussed about the plan.
Discuss! Let us discuss the problem.

native.tip: discuss 本身就有“谈论”的意思，直接接宾语。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “We discussed about the plan.”？😅 discuss 自带“谈论”的意思，后面直接接内容：“We discussed the plan.”。跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“discuss”。discuss 后不加 about！免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Discuss already means “talk about”, so go straight to the object.
en.caption: Do you say “We discussed about the plan.”? 😅 Discuss already means talk about, so no about is needed: “We discussed the plan.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
